name: Single Product Page Customizer with Variation Swatches for WooCommerce
author: WebCartisan

sections.description:
Best Single Product Page Customizer for WooCommerce to enhance your online store with responsive design, variations table, AJAX add to cart, quantity controls, custom product options, and more

Single Product Page Customizer with Variation Swatches for WooCommerce is a comprehensive WordPress plugin that provides eCommerce store owners with complete control over their WooCommerce single product pages. It’s one of the best plugins to customize WooCommerce products intuitively.

No more boring designs on your store’s product page. With our responsive WooCommerce plugin, now you have the freedom to do whatever amazing you want to do to your product display. Our product page customizer offers a simplified approach for editing WooCommerce product pages with responsive functionality.

Apart from tons of custom product options, the key component of our WordPress plugin is the advanced WooCommerce Variation Swatches feature. It enables custom product fields and product variations to be displayed using radio buttons, images, colors, or buttons. Variation swatches on WooCommerce also streamlines the purchasing process with features like Ajax add-to-cart functionality to make the pages lightning fast.

Whether the goal is to improve user experience, create stunning product fields to increase sales, or integrate custom elements, this plugin acts as an effortless WooCommerce product customizer.

Compatible Themes

Our plugin is tested and fully compatible with these popular WordPress themes:

Twenty Twenty-Four – Latest default WordPress theme
Twenty Twenty-Five – Modern default WordPress theme
Astra – Fast, lightweight WooCommerce theme
Futurio Storefront – Official WooCommerce theme
Hello Elementor – Minimal theme for Elementor
Kadence – Modern customizable theme
OceanWP – Feature-rich eCommerce theme

What Our Single Product Customizer Plugin Offers

Single Product Page Customizer with variation swatches provides a comprehensive suite of tools designed to enhance the functionality, responsiveness, aesthetics, and user experience of your WooCommerce product pages.

From advanced variation displays to streamlined checkout options, here’s what this WooCommerce single product addon offers:

Cart & Quantity Management

Optimizing the product fields and pages is essential for converting casual browsers into committed buyers on the WooCommerce store. The default WooCommerce interface, while functional, often lacks the nuance required for a truly seamless user experience. The following features of the single product page customizer with variation swatches for WooCommece plugin focus entirely on the transaction mechanism…

Enable Plus, Minus Buttons for Increase/Decrease Quantity

To improve the responsiveness of the WooCommerce store, this feature adds distinct Plus (+) and Minus (-) buttons next to the input product field. This allows users to adjust quantities effortlessly with a single click/tap and shop owners to maintain a properly responsive website.

Live Demo of Plus Minus Button | Documentation

Enable Ajax Add to Cart Button in Single Product Page

Statistics show that people buy more items from the stores that have Ajax add to cart than the default WooCommerce settings. With our Single Product Page Customizer for WooCommerce product addon plugin, you can enable this AJAX functionality, allowing customers to add items to their cart instantly without refreshing the whole page.

Live Demo of Ajax Add to Cart | Documentation

Change “Add to Cart” Button Text

The standard “Add to Cart” label may not fit the tone or strategy of every online store. This option gives you the flexibility to rename the button to something more compelling or relevant to your specific products.

Live Demo | Documentation

Hide “Add to Cart” Button

For catalog-mode websites or products that are temporarily unavailable, displaying a purchasing button can be misleading. This feature allows you to completely remove the “Add to Cart” button from the WooCommerce product page, ensuring that users can view the product without the option to purchase.

Live Demo | Documentation

Enable Min/Max Quantity Limits

With our Single Product Customizer for WooCommerce, you can enable minimum or maximum quantity limits for your products. This helps prevent the wholesale abuse and ensures that minimum order requirements are met. Every store owner needs to control purchase volumes to keep fairness in the business and avoid losses. Ultimately prevent customers from ordering too few or too many items in a single transaction.

Live Demo | Documentation

Your suggestions are the most important factors that will make this plugin even better. So, please let us know your valuable opinion on our plugin.

Product Variation Swatches for WooCommerce

The product variation swatches for WooCommerce feature replaces standard dropdowns with interactive variation swatches for WooCommerce single product pages. This allows you to display product variations as Colors, Images, Radio Buttons, or Text Buttons for a modern, high-converting look.

Live Demo | Documentation

Variation Table Show for Variation Product

The Variation Table feature of Single Product Page Customizer lists all available options in a structured table format. This makes it easier for customers to compare specifications and select the exact combination they need.

Live Demo | Documentation

Variation Reset Text Change

The small “Clear” text that appears after a customer selects a variation is often easy to overlook. This feature in our WooCommerce product page editor allows you to customize the text of this reset link to something more descriptive, such as “Reset Selection” or “Clear Options,” improving navigation clarity.

Live Demo | Documentation

Layout & Visibility Control

The default WooCommerce layout often includes metadata, like SKUs, tags, and categories, that may not be relevant to your specific audience. Single Product Customizer has all of these features that solve the timely problems. You can easily toggle the visibility of specific elements, hiding price tags for catalog-mode sites or removing related product sections to prevent user exit.

Remove Product SKU, Category, Tag Name

Product pages often become cluttered with metadata that is irrelevant to the average shopper. This feature in our WooCommerce single product page customizer provides a simple toggle to hide the SKU, Category, and Tag information. Thus, resulting in a cleaner interface that keeps the focus entirely on the product and the call-to-action.

Live Demo | Documentation

Remove Related Product Section

While cross-selling is valuable, the default “Related Products” section can sometimes distract users or clutter the bottom of the page. With our single product customizer plugin, you can control whether you want to show or remove the related product section. Easily customize WooCommerce product pages and disable this section entirely.

Live Demo | Documentation

Hide Price from Single Product Page

For B2B stores, wholesale catalogs, or “Call for Price” items, displaying a public price tag is often not desired. This feature enables you to hide the price from the WooCommerce single product page, allowing you to showcase products without revealing costs immediately.

Live Demo | Documentation

Hide Short Description

In certain layouts, the short description pushes critical elements like the “Add to Cart” button too far down the page (below the fold). By using our single product page customizer, you can choose to hide the short description and optimize the screen real estate to prioritize the purchasing buttons. This optimization is vital for mobile users, where vertical screen space is at a premium. By reducing the need to scroll, you ensure the purchase action is instantly visible.

Live Demo | Documentation

Move Image Section to the Right Side

To differentiate your store from the standard WooCommerce layout, this design option allows you to flip the page structure. By moving the product image gallery to the right side and the text to the left, you can offer a fresh, unique visual experience.

Live Demo | Documentation

Related Product Categories Show as a Grid Format

Instead of simply showing individual related products, you may want to encourage broader browsing. This feature in our single product page customizer allows you to display related product categories in an attractive grid format on the detail page.

Live Demo | Documentation

Text & Label Customization

Single Product Page Customizer for WooCommerce is one of the best product page editor plugins for WordPress to make you wealthy with the feature-rich plugin for text & label customization. The text & label customization tools allow you to communicate more effectively, serving as a WooCommerce backorder plugin.

Change the Sale Badge text on WooCommerce

With this WooCommerce product page editor, you can replace the standard text with specific, high-impact messaging like “20% OFF,” “Hot Deal,” or “Limited Time” to better highlight your promotions.

Live Demo | Documentation

Out of Stock Text Change

Standard “Out of Stock” messages can feel discouraging and lead to site exits. Customize this text to be more communicative or inviting, such as “Restocking Soon” or “Sold Out – Check Back Later.” This keeps the customers interested even when inventory is low.

Live Demo | Documentation

On Backorder Text Change

This setting in our product customizer allows you to rewrite the default backorder notification to clearly explain the status, such as “Pre-order Now” or “Ships in 2 Weeks,” ensuring transparency.

Live Demo | Documentation

Customize Related Product Title

The default heading “Related Products” is functional but not very persuasive. This tool allows you to rename the section title in a WooCommerce product page to something more engaging, like “You May Also Like,” “Complete the Look,” or “Customers Also Bought,” to drive more clicks.

Live Demo | Documentation

WooCommerce Default Tab Label Change

Default tab labels like “Description” or “Additional Information” might not align with your specific content strategy. With our single product page customizer, you can easily rename these standard tabs to be more descriptive and brand-relevant, such as changing “Reviews” to “Customer Feedback.”

Live Demo | Documentation

Advanced Content & Tabs

Add custom content and specialized tabs directly into your product layout without touching a line of code. Download the Single Product Page Customizer now to effortlessly attach new information tabs alongside existing ones or display global message banners to alert users of important updates.

Custom Message Show in Detail Page

Customizing urgent information, such as shipping delays or special offers, is often difficult without editing the WooCommerce theme code or hiring a developer. This feature in our single product page customizer lets you insert a custom text message banner directly onto the product detail page to inform customers instantly.

Live Demo | Documentation

Custom Tab Attach with Before Existing WooCommerce Tab

Standard product tabs are often insufficient for detailed information like sizing charts, video demos, or shipping policies. Our WooCommerce single product page customizer lets you create and attach new custom tabs to the product page and position them exactly where you need them relative to existing tabs.

Live Demo | Documentation

Additional Content to Attach in the Detail Page

Sometimes store owners need to add specific content to areas outside the standard description field. This feature provides flexible hooks to inject custom content (text, HTML, or media) into various locations on the single product page. As a result, this allows you to deeply customize WooCommerce product pages.

Live Demo | Documentation

Mobile Responsiveness & High-Speed Performance

Single Product Page Customizer for WooCommerce plugin is fully mobile responsive and ensures high-speed performance for your web store.

Our single product page customizer WP plugin is engineered with lightweight, clean code to ensure it adds powerful functionality without bloating your site’s load times. Furthermore, every element, from the variation swatches to the quantity buttons, is fully responsive by design. We ensure a seamless mobile experience where layouts adapt intelligently to fit smartphones and tablets perfectly.

Our touch-friendly interface guarantees that product galleries and call-to-action buttons operate smoothly on touchscreens, eliminating navigation errors.

For store owners ready to maximize their conversion potential, the Pro version of our Single product page customizer with Variation Swatches for the WooCommerce plugin unlocks a suite of sophisticated tools designed for high-volume and specialized e-commerce.

Imagine dramatically speeding up your shopping flow with instant Ajax Add-to-Cart functionality or protecting your profit margins by enforcing strict Minimum and Maximum quantity rules. By investing in the Pro version, you can customize WooCommerce single product page with the advanced capabilities to boost your overall sales.

The key features of the most effective WooCommerce single product page editor empower store owners to optimize product pages for higher engagement and conversions. Thus, your product will be displayed in a way that customers can’t move without completing the checkout!

sections.installation:
Before you install this single product page customizer plugin, make sure you have:

WordPress 6.9 or newer is installed.
WooCommerce plugin installed and activated.

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin.
  2. Search for “Single Product Page Customizer with Variation Swatches for WooCommerce”.
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”.
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Single Product Customizer to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
How do I install the plugin?

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin.
  2. Search for “Single Product Page Customizer with Variation Swatches for WooCommerce”.
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”.
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Single Product Customizer to configure the plugin.

Does this plugin work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, the plugin is designed to be compatible with any WordPress theme that follows standard WooCommerce templates.

Is the free version limited in functionality?

The free version includes a robust set of basic features that are sufficient for many stores. The Pro version adds advanced features like Ajax Add to Cart and Min/Max Quantity limits.
